notablePrerequisites: None of the involved permanents have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Palladium Myr by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Myr Galvanizer by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping each other Myr you control.
Activate Palladium Myr by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Phyrexian Metamorph by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping each other Myr you control.
Repeat.
